title: Edit Distance
contract: Return the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions, and replacements to transform a into b, each costing 1.
optimal: int[] previous=new int[b.length()+1];for(int j=0;j<=b.length();j++)previous[j]=j;for(int i=1;i<=a.length();i++){int[] current=new int[b.length()+1];current[0]=i;for(int j=1;j<=b.length();j++)current[j]=a.charAt(i-1)==b.charAt(j-1)?previous[j-1]:1+Math.min(previous[j-1],Math.min(previous[j],current[j-1]));previous=current;emit("Insert, delete, or replace at each prefix pair","source prefix",a.substring(0,i),"cost row",previous);}return previous[b.length()];
reasoning: For a mismatch, try all three editing operations recursively.
The empty-string base cases are the number of remaining insertions or deletions, not zero.
The previous diagonal represents replacement, above deletion, and current left insertion. Keep both rows until the current row is complete.
